entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single 2x2 GAME TEXTURE ATLAS containing four independent square military equipment casing plates, for NSDF ammo, repair and weapon pickups. Image 1 is only the faction-paint and insignia reference, NOT an atlas to copy. Full square canvas divided EXACTLY at x=50% and y=50%, no gutters or blank margins; four equal square cells. All four cells have muted olive-brown utilitarian metal and a clean regular off-white five-point star matching the reference. Each cell is flat orthographic material artwork, NOT a 3D box or object scene. A simple clean symmetrical faction insignia centered within the middle 40 percent of each cell; ample quiet metal around it, shallow utilitarian panel frame near each cell's edge, fine restrained paint chips and small rivets, no excessive scratch noise. Important PICKUP TYPE accent: upper-left cell has strong cobalt BLUE painted side bands and lower strip for AMMO; upper-right has strong GREEN painted side bands/lower strip for REPAIR; lower-left has strong RED side bands/lower strip for CANNON/ROCKET weapons; lower-right has strong AMBER/ORANGE side bands/lower strip for MORTAR/SPECIAL weapons. Type-color bands occupy about 15 percent of each cell's area and are visibly different from the quieter faction finish. Keep the center symbol color faction-correct. No words, labels, letters, numbers, cross, perspective, cast shadows, gloss highlights, background, bloom, watermark or presentation layout. Continuous full-bleed texture atlas ONLY. Star shapes must be regular, with five equal arms, exact bilateral symmetry, one tip straight up. Four equal cells, each containing one and only one small centered insignia.
